rules.agent: Discretionary agentic book. Cursor agent decides via stocks.decide from shared candidates. Baseline — not auto-traded by the engine.
rules.bigbeat_gap: Long when EPS surprise >15%, first open gaps up >5% vs prior close, and SPY is above its 50-day SMA. 10% equity, max 8, hold 3 days, no stop.
rules.guidance_beat: Long when 8-K/press release shows raised guidance AND EPS beat >8%, with the release out before the entry open. 10% equity, max 8, hold 5, no stop.
rules.beat5_raise: Long on EPS beat >5% plus raised outlook. No SPY regime filter. 10% equity, max 8, hold 5 days, no stop.
rules.miss_short: Short when EPS misses by more than 10% AND the stock gaps down >5% at the first open. 5% equity, max 4, hold 2 days, hard 8% stop.
rules.news_event: Config-driven news book (config/strategies/news_event.yaml). Defaults: long acquisition_target / big_contract / fda_approval / guidance_raise; short fraud_probe / guidance_cut / short_report / dilution; exclude shareholder_alert; 5% equity, max 6, hold 2 days, 8% stop, entry next_bar. Edit YAML to retune — engine reloads on next tick. Paper shorts — no borrow model.
rules.guidance_raise_tuned: Config: long guidance_raise only · 5% · max 15 · hold 5d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/guidance_raise_tuned.yaml). Box test +11.2%.
rules.dilution_shorts_tuned: Config: short dilution · 5% · max 8 · hold 3d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/dilution_shorts_tuned.yaml). Paper shorts. Box test +10.0%.
rules.quality_longs_tuned: Config: long guidance_raise / acquisition_target / big_contract · 5% · max 15 · hold 5d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/quality_longs_tuned.yaml). Box test +4.8%.
rules.guidance_raise_score: Config: long guidance_raise · score-scaled size (|EPS| or |gap| vs 10%, 0.25x–2x) · max 8 · hold 2d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/guidance_raise_score.yaml). Box test +4.5%.
rules.gap_filtered_guidance: Config: long guidance_raise with gap ≥5% · 5% · max 8 · hold 5d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/gap_filtered_guidance.yaml). Box test +4.4%.
rules.wide_capacity: Config: quality longs · 5% · max 15 · hold 2d · no stop · next_open (config/strategies/wide_capacity.yaml). Box test +2.1%.
